text:
jess: quick check — planning to onboard elysium-4.5b-q4 today. weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/elysium/4.5b/q4/ and manifest at s3://redwood-models/elysium/4.5b/q4/manifest.json
omar: thanks. can you confirm tokenizer type + vocab size? we had issues last time with mixed spm models.
jess: sentencepiece, model file spm.model v0.1.95, vocab 50272. also added a fallback tokenizer config pointing at a lowercase normalizer due to punctuation mismatch in some datasets.
kai: small heads-up — quant profile q4a here reduces FP errors for long-context but changes eos scoring slightly. put a note in the catalog metadata: "quant_delta: -0.8% perplexity on eval-set-a"
len: for the catalog entry, are we pinning alias elysium-4.5b:q4 or creating variant elysium-4.5b:q4a? recommendation: create variant and pin the canary to the variant so main 4.5b stays stable.
jess: creating variant elysium-4.5b@q4a (semver 4.5.0-q4a). will request canary in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 first.
omar: config lint results? did the onboard CI catch any schema mismatches? share the manifest snippet if possible.
jess: pasted manifest snippet:
```json
{
  "model_name": "elysium-4.5b",
  "variant": "q4a",
  "weights_uri": "s3://redwood-models/elysium/4.5b/q4/model.pt",
  "tokenizer_uri": "s3://redwood-models/elysium/4.5b/q4/spm.model",
  "quant_profile": "q4a",
  "max_seq": 2048
}
```
kai: Looks ok. one nit: add "kv_cache_compat": true if we expect cross-variant cache reuse in rollouts. else we might flush which hurts latency.
jess: added kv_cache_compat: true and re-run `./tools/catalog-lint --manifest path/to/manifest.json` locally — passed.
sre-bot: preflight check passed: infra quota ok in eu-west-1 (GPUs available: 24), us-west-2 (GPUs available: 18). No IP or network policy violations detected.
len: ops question — for the canary do we want 5% traffic on hosted API and 0.5 nodes in Dedicated? i'll set autoscale min to 0.5 and max to 4 for the canary pool.
omar: yeah 5% on hosted is fine. also add fallback to elysium-4.5b@fp16 if any runtime kernel mismatch happens. add to rollout policy:
```yaml
rollout:
  mode: canary
  canary_fraction: 0.05
  regions: ["eu-west-1","us-west-2"]
  fallback_variants: ["elysium-4.5b@fp16"]
```
jess: done. scheduling canary start at 17:30 UTC. pinging @kai for eval metrics watch.
kai: i'll wire eval hooks: perplexity, token_eos_bias, latency_p50/p95, and a small prompt-regression suite. will report after 30m.
sre-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary for 1925008000. Validation hooks attached.
deploy-bot: canary job queued: job_id=job_elf_1925. will emit success/failure in this thread.
len: small reminder — region enablement internal flag `catalog.enable_region` needs eu-west-1 set to true for this variant. jess can you toggle?
jess: toggled eu-west-1 and us-west-2 in catalog UI, saved.
omar: one last check — tokenizer normalizer change might affect embeddings. recommend running 1k example prompts through embed pipeline and compare cosine diffs; if >0.02 for >10% of prompts, raise regression alert.
kai: doing that now. first 1k run should finish in ~12m — will post summary.
jess: thanks all — i'll wait for the embed sanity and the eval metrics before flipping traffic. if anyone wants to abort before 18:00 UTC, shout here. :thumbsup:
